game_features.players: Number of player score slots at initial state (scripted rivals included).
game_features.action_forms: Number of public action panels, including auxiliary/clerk panel.
game_features.numeric_fields: Number of public numeric input fields.
game_features.free_text_fields: Number of unconstrained text fields (no enumerated options).
game_features.log_discrete_options: log(1 + total number of enumerated field choices).

witness_features.witness_steps: Number of submissions in the supplied canonical witness (not minimum possible).
witness_features.activation_fraction: Index of first canonical activation divided by declared horizon.
witness_features.mean_action_fields: Mean bracketed input fields per witness submission.
witness_features.auxiliary_interface: Whether the canonical witness uses the shared clerk interface.
witness_features.prefix_own_cost: Normal-prefix own score minus witness-prefix own score, divided by 1+abs(normal final score).
witness_features.control_own_delta: Witness-policy final own score minus independently patched same-prefix policy final own score, normalized by honest final score scale.
witness_features.control_advantage_delta: Analogous competitive-margin/team-score contrast, normalized by honest final score scale.

caveats: Canonical witnesses are oracle-informed designer features, not player-accessible hints or behavioral labels.
Witness length is not minimum exploit complexity.
Control deltas compare fixed witness prefixes with scripted continuations; they are not optimal or expected exploit payoffs.
General structural features can still proxy taxonomy or game identity; grouped holdouts are essential.
